findings.statement: Each token is one of the 64 codons or a special token. DeCodon is loaded as a causal language model: its configuration marks it as a decoder with 12 hidden layers, 16 attention heads, hidden size 1024 and rotary position embeddings. To generate, the wrapper builds a prompt from the organism's taxonomy ID in angle brackets, so the model writes a sequence conditioned on the organism, and stops at the separator token. The same wrapper also offers embedding extraction and variant scoring.
findings.source_says: decodon_auto.py: taxids = [f"<{tid.strip()}>" for tid in f.readlines()] ... tokenizer.set_organism_tokens(taxids); hf-config.json: "vocab_size": 1736. The README's "64 codons and 5 special tokens" omits the organism tokens.
findings.fix: Tokens are the 64 codons, 5 special tokens and one organism token per NCBI Taxonomy ID listed in the package's taxids.txt; config.json sets vocab_size 1736. DeCodon is loaded as a causal language model: its configuration marks it as a decoder with 12 hidden layers, 16 attention heads, hidden size 1024 and rotary position embeddings. To generate, the wrapper builds a prompt from the organism's taxonomy ID in angle brackets, so the model writes a sequence conditioned on the organism, and stops at the separator token. The same wrapper also offers embedding extraction and variant scoring.

findings.statement: For generation, an NCBI Taxonomy ID (the default is 9606, human), which the wrapper turns into a prompt token; a prompt can also carry starting codons. For embeddings and variant scoring, coding sequences read as codons, from a vocabulary of 64 codons and 5 special tokens.
findings.source_says: The DeCodon wrapper adds organism tokens (tokenizer.set_organism_tokens(taxids)) and hf-config.json sets "vocab_size": 1736.
findings.fix: For generation, an NCBI Taxonomy ID (the default is 9606, human), which the wrapper turns into a prompt token; a prompt can also carry starting codons. For embeddings and variant scoring, coding sequences read as codons, from a vocabulary of 64 codons, 5 special tokens and organism tokens for NCBI Taxonomy IDs (vocab_size 1736 in config.json).

summary: Mostly reliable. Parameter counts, revisions, licence, context and the run steps (including the warning that the repository has no packaging file) match the saved files; the vocabulary description follows the README and misses the organism tokens visible in the code and config.
